
## Install

1. On your Android phone, open this page and download **looting-glass-android-VERSION.apk** under *Assets* below.
2. Open the downloaded file. When Android asks, allow your browser to install apps, then tap **Install**.
3. To update later, install the newer APK the same way; your settings are kept.

Needs Android 8 or newer on a 64-bit phone. If you have an earlier test build ("Loot Lens" or a Looting Glass APK sent directly), uninstall it first: it was signed with a different key.

Usage: pick the game, platform and league, tap **Take photo**, zoom in until the item tooltip fills the frame and capture. Tap a search filter to switch it on or off; the search re-runs.
